report.summary: Patient P-D011 (34, commercial high-deductible plan, deductible not met, no transport benefit, home tract 17031062000) needs help with medication costs and transportation to appointments. Eligibility-checked options below. For med_cost: the patient is a current clinic patient, so the Clinic Rx Fund (short-term copay help) is the best first option; Rx Bridge Program offers same-day help after pre-approval (requires MRN + medication list); Community Pharmacy Assistance can help apply for manufacturer programs (Extra Help is unlikely given commercial coverage and age 34). For transport: no plan transport benefit, so Medicaid Ride Line (Medicaid members only) and Senior Shuttle West (age 60+) are not eligible. Rx Bridge Program pre-approval may also cover transport; Paratransit Info Desk (ADA certification, ~21-day decision) is a longer-term fallback if the patient qualifies.

options.name: Rx Bridge Program
options.how_to_access: Pre-approval required (submit MRN and medication list via program portal); approved patients receive help same day.
